d.why: Only in X-Men: TAS 'Orphan's End' (S3), where she is the Shi'ar witness that Raknar is trying to kill, the target the episode is about.
In both parts of X-Men: TAS 'Proteus' (S4), as Moira's ex-husband and the father Proteus is hunting.
Only in X-Men: TAS 'Old Soldiers' (S5), where she points Logan toward her father and later tells him Andre was a double agent: a helper in Wolverine's story, and her father has no file in the app.
Only in X-Men: TAS 'Hidden Agendas' (S5), where he is the villain running the secret program that tries to recruit Sam Guthrie and then orders the X-Men eliminated.

Only in X-Men: TAS 'The Lotus and the Steel' (S4), where she is a villager who urges Logan to help against the Silver Samurai; her brother Soichi is also only in that episode, so the tie does not save her.
Only in X-Men: TAS 'Cold Vengeance' (S1), where his choices drive the plot: out of jealousy he leads Wolverine into Sabretooth's trap, then distracts Sabretooth and saves Wolverine's life.
Only in X-Men: TAS 'Slave Island' (S1), where he is the Genoshan ruler enslaving mutants, the episode's villain.
Jubilee's foster mother, in both parts of 'Night of the Sentinels' (S1) and with a cameo in 'The Juggernaut Returns' (S3) of X-Men: TAS.
Only in X-Men: TAS 'One Man's Worth' Part 1 (S4), where it is the main antagonist that sends Fitzroy back to kill the young Xavier.
Only in X-Men: TAS 'The Lotus and the Steel' (S4), where he is Logan's old spiritual teacher who counsels him: a mentor and helper in Wolverine's story against the Silver Samurai.

Only in X-Men: TAS 'Storm Front' Part II (S5), where he leads the Belganian resistance and helps Wolverine and Beast free Arkon's slaves: a helper in Storm's story, and no other resistance member has a file.
In X-Men: TAS 'A Rogue's Tale' (S2), where her buried psyche is the antagonist fighting Rogue, plus an on-screen cameo in 'Love in Vain'.
In X-Men: TAS 'Phoenix Saga' Parts IV and V (S3) and in 'Orphan's End' (S3).
In X-Men: TAS 'X-Ternally Yours' (S2), and in X-Men '97 at Gambit's funeral in 'Bright Eyes' (S1) and in 'The Dead Man's Hand' (S2).
Only in X-Men: TAS 'Cold Vengeance' (S1), where the Inuit elder takes in Wolverine and is one of the villagers Sabretooth holds hostage: a host in Wolverine's fight with Sabretooth.
In X-Men: TAS 'Repo Man' (S2) with Alpha Flight, and in a cameo with the team in X-Men '97 'Tolerance Is Extinction' Part 3 (S1).
Only in X-Men: TAS 'Longshot' (S5), where he is one of Mojo's hunters and Longshot knocks him out: a henchman, not the episode's main villain, Mojo.
Only in X-Men: TAS 'Orphan's End' (S3), where he is the corrupt Shi'ar commander hunting Jandra, the episode's villain.
With the Starjammers in X-Men: TAS 'Phoenix Saga' Parts IV and V (S3) and in 'Orphan's End' (S3).
Only in X-Men: TAS 'Descent' (S5), where she takes Essex's treatments and flees him, and she is kept because she is the wife of Mister Sinister, who has a file.
In X-Men: TAS 'No Mutant Is an Island' (S5), and with the Acolytes in X-Men '97 'Strange Land, Savage Heart' (S2).
In X-Men: TAS, with cameos in 'Night of the Sentinels' Part 1 (S1) and 'Repo Man' (S2), and as the young mutant the episode is about in 'Hidden Agendas' (S5).
Only in X-Men: TAS 'No Mutant Is an Island' (S5), where Scott's childhood friend who runs the orphanage helps Cyclops stop Killgrave: a helper in his story.
Only in X-Men: TAS 'Repo Man' (S2), as one Alpha Flight member who helps capture Wolverine and then rebels with the team; a later 'appearance' is only Morph impersonating him.
In both parts of X-Men: TAS 'Time Fugitives' (S2), where she chairs the plague hearing.
MjNari's mother, in X-Men: TAS 'Whatever It Takes' (S2) and with a cameo in 'Sanctuary' Part I (S4).

Ka-Zar's wife, in several Savage Land episodes of X-Men: TAS: she is chased by Sauron, held prisoner in Sinister's citadel in 'Reunion' Part Two, and has a cameo in 'Savage Land, Strange Heart' Part Two.
